name: Zoom Wipe Right
description: The camera zooms into the first clip and back out, then the second clip wipes in from left to right. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: zoom_quickness
params.description: Part of the zoom phase spent zooming in (capped at 0.5)
